item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)

expect.asks_about: Whether cleanup means removing countertop clutter or changing the kitchen's appearance.

item.title: Clean Up This Kitchen
item.tests: Tests conservative interpretation of a vague cleanup request, clearing clutter without inventing a renovation.

answer_sheet.Meaning of cleanup: Clear the loose clutter off the counter, not a renovation.
answer_sheet.Permanent kitchen features: Keep the brown cabinets, beige tiles, counter material and existing kitchen layout.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Keep it a realistic photo with the same wide framing; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The countertop looks visibly tidier, with loose clutter removed.
The original brown wooden cabinets and beige tiles remain, rather than being replaced with renovated finishes.
The kitchen layout, fixed fixtures and viewpoint match the source.
Cleared counter areas look continuous and natural, without obvious erasure marks or floating object remnants.

turns.text: Can you clean up this pic? I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Yes—I can remove the countertop clutter and make the kitchen look tidier while keeping the cabinets, sinks, tiles, and layout unchanged.

**Cheapest listed option on your free plan:**
- **Model:** Flux 2 Klein
- **Output:** 1 image, up to **640 px** on its longest edge
- **Listed cost:** **from 5 credits per image**

That’s the lowest listed image-editing price available here. I can’t verify your balance or an exact final quote with the connected tools, so **5 credits is a starting price, not a guaranteed total**. A “shorter” option doesn’t apply to a still photo; one 640 px image is already the smallest listed option.

**Nothing has been run or spent.** Would you like that decluttering edit, or did you mean improving the lighting and sharpness instead?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that. Just remove the loose countertop clutter; keep the permanent kitchen features and the same wide, realistic framing.

turns.agent:
The edit was refused because your account has insufficient credits. **No image was generated and no credits were spent.**

We already selected the cheapest listed edit: one 640 px image with Flux 2 Klein, starting at 5 credits. There isn’t a cheaper or smaller image-edit option listed here, so I haven’t retried.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit this kitchen photo realistically: remove only the loose countertop clutter, including bottles, cans, dishes, bowls, paper towel roll, bags, cloths, and other small movable countertop items. Leave clean, empty countertop surfaces. Preserve all permanent kitchen features exactly: wooden cabinets and handles, tiled backsplash, countertops, both sinks and faucets, window, walls, and fixed fixtures. Preserve the exact original wide framing, viewpoint, perspective, aspect ratio, natural lighting, colors, and realistic photographic appearance. Do not remodel, crop, change cabinetry, add objects, or alter the layout.
